text: On October 8, 2019, the Toronto Music Advisory Committee elected a Co-Chair for a term of office ending December 31, 2020 and until successor is appointed. The Committee will elect a member of the public as Co-Chair for a term of office ending November 14, 2022.
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Mary An Blom as Co-Chair of the Toronto Music Advisory Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022.
